label: BBL
tagline_html: Bulk Graph Bundler is a curation project. Each Discrete Lair is a one-off, named, theme-driven bundle of trading cards the market sells by weight. Curation is the labor. The labor is the value.
footer_note: Sandbox preview on diamondlegendz.com. Commercial storefront will live elsewhere.

lairs.title: Tithe
lairs.subtitle: the men they send
lairs.blurb: Every institution has a face it shows when it comes to collect. A noble standing while a servant scrubs the floor behind her. A knight extending a collection plate. A vampire priest seated with the back of her hand offered to a kneeling supplicant. Ten cards. Different guilds, different blocks, same job description.

_deprecated_lairs_note: Drone (Discrete Lair 002) was deprecated 2026-05-18 after the constellation visualization made its weakness visible. The cohesion metric isn't 'card-to-card edges' specifically — 2-step or longer paths through external resonance nodes (a shared character, source-tale, mechanic, or design ancestor that bridges two cards) count as substrate. The test is whether the majority of cards land in a single connected component vs. scattered as isolated dots each tied only to their own private externals. Drone fails this: most cards have personal artist / character / source nodes that don't bridge anywhere. Bundle JSON, michi-inserts/drone/, and card-cache/drone/ are retained on disk; lair.html?lair=drone still resolves for direct testing. Will resurrect when the underlying graph accumulates bridging edges.
